title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace
description:
Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces, com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace para atuar no processo de onboarding dos clientes, garantindo a correta integração de sistemas, cadastro de produtos e organização das informações nos canais de venda.

Essa posição exige atenção a detalhes, capacidade analítica e organização. Não buscamos alguém apenas rápido(a), mas alguém que tenha cuidado com processos, análise e qualidade das informações.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar no processo de onboarding de novos clientes após o fechamento comercial, organizando as etapas de cadastro e integração

• Realizar cadastro e atualização de produtos nos principais marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Magalu, Shopee, entre outros)

• Integrar hubs de anúncios com ERP, garantindo consistência entre sistemas e canais de venda

• Preencher fichas técnicas diretamente nos marketplaces, seguindo as diretrizes de cada plataforma

• Trabalhar com ferramentas como Magis5, Bling e sistemas de conciliação, apoiando a estruturação operacional das contas

• Organizar e tratar dados em Excel e Google Sheets para controle e atualização de cadastros

• Monitorar possíveis inconsistências entre sistemas, anúncios e produtos cadastrados

• Participar das rotinas diárias com o time (daily meetings) para alinhamento das demandas e prioridades

• Atuar de forma resolutiva, acompanhando a lista de demandas priorizadas pela liderança da área


Requisitos

• Excel intermediário

• Experiência com cadastro de produtos ou operações em marketplaces

• Organização, atenção a detalhes e senso de responsabilidade

• Perfil proativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender

• Facilidade para trabalhar com processos estruturados e demandas simultâneas


Diferenciais

• Experiência com hubs de integração (Magis5, Anymarket, Tray ou similares)

• Vivência em operações multicanal e e-commerce

• Conhecimento de diferentes marketplaces

• Experiência com ERP Bling ou sistemas de conciliação


O que oferecemos

• Remuneração de R$ 3.000,00 (PJ)

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo

• Oportunidade de aprendizado contínuo em operação de marketplaces

• Atuação próxima a projetos reais de crescimento dos clientes


Modelo de trabalho

• 100% remoto

• Contratação PJ

• Participação em alinhamentos diários com o time

title: Lead Application Support Engineer
description:
MUST BE LOCATED IN BRAZIL


Position: Lead App Support Engineer – Sales Platform

Duration: 12-month Contract

Hours: 8 – 5PM EST

Pay Rate: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years in Production Support, SRE, or Application Operations
  • Strong debugging skills with Node.js and React/Angular
  • Experience with MongoDB and SQL Server
  • Familiarity with APM, logging, and monitoring tools
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead incident resolution


Plusses:

  • Experience with Ionic mobile or hybrid applications
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow IMT & RCA workflows
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and pipelines


Day to Day:

  • Monitor production applications to ensure stability, performance, and availability
  • Lead and participate in incident triage, troubleshooting, and resolution
  • Analyze system failures and apply break‑fix code or configuration changes as needed
  • Validate fixes in lower environments and coordinate with engineering for long‑term solutions
  • Perform proactive health checks, performance tuning, and reliability improvements
  • Support release activities and ensure smooth and compliant deployments
  • Provide clear communication and reporting to stakeholders during and after incidents


Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking a Lead App Support Engineer to support a large health insurance client of ours. The Application Support Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of core enterprise applications. The engineer will lead incident response efforts, perform proactive monitoring, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement break‑fix solutions to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence. This role also partners closely with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to drive continuous improvement and maintain operational excellence. Strong analytical skills, technical depth, and clear communication are essential to success.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Incident Management & On‑Call: Lead rapid incident response, drive MTTA/MTTR improvements, and coordinate multi‑team engagements
  • Monitoring, Observability & Reliability: Maintain and enhance dashboards, alerts, and performance indicators
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Management: Conduct deep‑dive analysis, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions
  • Break‑Fix Implementation: Diagnose issues, develop and deploy break‑fix solutions, validate changes, and ensure stable production operation
  • Change & Release Support: Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for deployments, validations, and post‑release monitoring
  • Communication & Reporting: Provide status updates, incident summaries, and performance reporting to leadership and stakeholders
  • Governance & Best Practices: Adhere to operational standards, documentation requirements, and continuous improvement frameworks

title: Engenheiro de Soluções
description:
Descrição

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
  • Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
  • Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
  • Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
  • Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
  • Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
  • Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
  • Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
  • Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
  • Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
  • Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
  • Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
  • Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
  • Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.


Habilidades Requeridas

  • Proficiência em mandarim
  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
  • Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
  • Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
  • Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
  • Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
  • Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
  • Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.


Atributos

  • Proatividade;

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Cold-Formed Steel Framing BIM Specialist (MWF)
description:
ENG has evolved, expanded and become increasingly complex, but continues to be dedicated to being a high-growth, well-run, profitable business with employees and contractors located throughout the world.

A modeler, as its very name says, is the one who models the buildings in Revit or similar programs. Depending on their seniority or expertise, they can model one or more disciplines. Modelers at ENG must also understand and review discipline specifications, project manuals, and submittals (Quality Analysis), and be able to read the design information provided by our clients to create accurate and constructible BIM models.

Mandatory Requirements:

  • An Upper Intermediate level of English is an absolute must.
  • Civil Engineering degree (Framing background).
  • +3 years of experience in BIM MEP.
  • Broad knowledge of Revit & Navisworks.

Desirable Requirements:

  • MWF software knowledge.
  • Experience in US-based projects.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: SQL Architect
description:
Job Title: Solution Architect / Technical Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities:

• We are seeking a seasoned Solution Architect / Technical Architect with 15+ years of IT experience, including 10+ years in public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure.

• Conduct AS-IS assessments of applications, design target state architectures, and obtain approvals from client architecture review boards.

• Drive cloud solutioning activities for large-scale Azure migrations and transformations.

• Design and build Azure Landing Zones, ensuring alignment with business, application, and infrastructure strategies.

• Provide Azure target architecture diagrams (HLD & LLD), BoM pricing, and licensing details.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

• Troubleshoot Azure and Windows environments, including processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory issues.

• Ensure projects meet stakeholder expectations, value-for-money considerations, and governance requirements.


Must Have Skills:

✔ Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM)

✔ Architecture frameworks and solution design expertise

✔ Cloud migration and transformation experience (on-prem to public cloud)

✔ Azure Landing Zone design and implementation

✔ Strong troubleshooting skills in Azure & Windows environments

✔ Experience across multiple industry domains (banking, healthcare, insurance)

✔ Stakeholder management and documentation (HLD, LLD, approvals, governance)


Good to Have:

  • Certifications: AZ-305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator)
  • Secondary Skills: Infrastructure/data storage design, business continuity/DR solutions, identity/governance/monitoring solutions
  • Tools: Project management tools (ADO), knowledge of pricing/licensing models


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Analista Front-End - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista Front-End - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuação em uma empresa global da área agrícola.
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Inglês avançado em escrita e conversação para comunicação com o time global.
  • Experiência com React e React Native.
  • Experiência em state managers (especialmente redux).
  • Experiência com projetos legado react.
  • Habilidade em debugging e side effects.
  • Experiência com Android e iOS. Estar a par de possíveis novos requisitos desses sistemas.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail
